newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-SA PINTO HANDED INTERNATIONAL BAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SA PINTO HANDED INTERNATIONAL BAN.

text.p: Sporting striker Ricardo Sa Pinto was banned on Tuesday from the national squad until the end of the 1998 World Cup for assaulting team coach Artur Jorge.
"The board of the Portuguese Soccer Federation decided to dispense with...Sa Pinto from selection to the national side until the end of the 1998 World Cup, " a statement said.
Sa Pinto, capped 19 times, struck Jorge at the team's training ground in March after being left out of the squad for a World Cup qualifier against Northern Ireland.
The federation decision followed an investigation into the incident by a special commission.
Sa Pinto, who had initially accused Jorge of insulting him, remains free to play for his club.
